issues.summary: ADR-0011 supersedes the unverified TongDaXin provider choice; Tushare Pro is active and the legacy data authority is retired and purged.
Declared label_formula does not drive the actual training label.
Daily data task references a missing Qlib synchronization script.
Current Qlib conversion replaces its destination non-atomically.
QM2-P0-014 establishes one Tushare Artifact/Dataset authority and a fixed-100 Qlib consumer view; the former annual feature authority was purged.
Official Factor Lab uses a Python-first candidate contract.
Factor Lab JSON registry can replace historical records.
Anti-overfit recent is not an isolated Frozen Test.
Official Factor Lab source under /tmp has durability risk.
Project Knowledge Center API and UI do not exist.
Git-to-Ledger parser/indexer exists; production deployment remains separate.

QM2-P0-005 implements bounded deterministic Factor Optimization v1 for declared lookback-window and factor-internal-weight parameters; predictive validation, threshold, random/Bayesian and distributed search remain separate future scope.
V7 Factor Lab combines Python-first research decisions, concrete parameters, loop control, dispatch, and result feedback without a formal ResearchDecision and Decision Validator boundary.
Ledger schema now has a dedicated ordered explicit-SQL runner with history, checksum, lock, up/down, and fresh-install integration; unrelated legacy schema paths remain outside this resolution.
Shared async contexts auto-commit while many services also commit internally, leaving transaction ownership inconsistent for atomic Ledger indexing.
Credential-bearing database defaults exist and shared async engine initialization may log the complete database URL.
A disposable opt-in PostgreSQL integration test exists and passes locally; CI PostgreSQL capability and scheduling remain unconfirmed.
Context schema v1 cannot encode fine-grained task IDs such as QM2-P0-002A2a2, so machine-readable next-task lists use parent QM2-P0-002.
Manifest v2 represents all current Ledger Domain families; historical v1 remains immutable with original evidence gaps.

The in-memory test double remains non-durable, while the async PostgreSQL Repository now has isolated PostgreSQL 15 transaction, rollback, savepoint, constraint, and cross-Session concurrency evidence.
Ledger migration, Repository/UoW, Manifest/Git indexing and CLI exist; production deployment and API/UI remain separate open scope.
Real PostgreSQL 15 Repository behavior passed with SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 and asyncpg 0.31.0; pinned SQLAlchemy 2.0.25 and asyncpg 0.29.0 runtime parity remains outstanding.
ADR-0010 and the Indexer require explicit trusted logical-ID to worktree binding; Manifest v1 absolute path remains informational.
Manifest v2 records repository_path or uri and validates it before constructing the unchanged Domain artifact.
Manifest v1 cannot construct complete Ledger Domain Bundles without inventing Task and child semantics; zero of seventeen historical v1 Runs are indexable, while v2 resolves future production.
QM2-P0-001F declares a result commit that differs from its containing commit.
The adjacent 2025 feature sidecar describes older bytes; exact Parquet bytes, not the stale sidecar, are authoritative for Legacy source identity.
Existing LightGBM training is not yet bound to the new Tushare Feature Dataset and exact Factor/Transform lineage; Qlib direct consumption of the new fixed-100 view is verified.
Manifest v2 self-reference is rejected for new Runs; committed v2 self-reference is narrowly warned and excluded from ChangedFile mapping without weakening other Git evidence.
The 003LF post-commit PostgreSQL test used nonexistent AnalyzedRun.git_consistency; QM2-P0-003LF1 uses evidence.consistent and evidence.warnings, and all four opt-in tests pass.

The current official Factor Lab source directory references FactorSpec, CandidateManifest, admission, evaluator and sandbox modules whose source files are absent from that bounded directory; only its surviving contracts and runbook evidence were reusable in QM2-P0-004.

QM2-P0-008 historical external failures remain immutable; QM2-P0-008F identified invalid_json_schema, added semantic Provider-schema normalization and safe classified diagnostics, and completed one admitted external Codex Campaign without changing ResearchDecision or Campaign controls.
Baseline and External Campaigns produced sibling Registry snapshots; QM2-P0-008G reconciled them into one immutable multi-parent canonical Snapshot without rewriting either branch.
The 2026 source ends before the 2026-07-17 Candidate Lock; Fresh Validation is awaiting its first strictly post-lock date and no real result exists.
QM2-P0-010 implements the persistent content-addressed Store and migrates the complete current reachable research graph; QM2-P0-011 completes the Store-backed runtime cutover and recovery drill.
QM2-P0-009 omitted 23 of 35 Git-proven business ChangedFiles. The original Run remains inconsistent; QM2-P0-009F adds complete immutable correction evidence and a corrects relationship.
Artifact Store and Runtime v1 are single-host local-filesystem only; NFS, cloud object storage, distributed locking/cache and deletion GC are unsupported.

QM2-P0-010 omitted only its own Manifest from both integrity Git inventories. The original Run remains immutable, inconsistent and non-indexable; QM2-P0-010F records the exact 42 changed and 28 added path evidence plus a corrects relationship without changing Store behavior or artifacts.
Tushare authority is locked through 2026-06-23; incremental collection, late-data revision policy and scheduled publication are not implemented.

QM2-P0-015F proves the two missing 2026H1 members were already delisted and adds an explicit lifecycle-aware Qlib capacity contract; all four historical strategies complete without replacement or fill.

The governed Tushare Artifact graph has no cash, conversion, merger-exchange or write-off settlement evidence for the two 2025 terminations. Strategy results are unaffected, but the 2025 and full-period Fixed-100 benchmark and related excess metrics remain noncanonical pending governed evidence.

QM2-P0-015H live capability evidence confirms the current Tushare account cannot access issuer announcements (anns_d) or structured merger endpoints, while available Tushare tables contain no complete settlement evidence. The task is blocked and publishes no benchmark revision.

Existing formal TopKDropout results persist actual positions but not the pre-trade target-weight object; QM2-P0-016 preserves deterministic Portfolio Targets separately and marks target-to-actual-target equality not verifiable instead of inferring it.
QM2-R1-002's candidate remained unrecoverable; QM2-R1-003 did not reconstruct it and instead established a complete forward artifact contract and reran skip-recent research from scratch.

QM2-R1-003 produced two fully replayable research locks that underperformed CSI300 in contaminated later-period reports; QM2-R1-004 now provides semantic and alpha-decomposition evidence without changing their research-only state.

QM2-R1-004 finds weak positive 2025 RankIC followed by negative 2026H1 RankIC and residual return. Costs and concentration are not the primary failure; the locks remain research-only and support at most stock-selection-overlay research.

Both R1-003 candidate Templates expose only one three-point optimizable parameter, so the frozen F1 direct-neighbor and F2 full factor spaces are identical. QM2-R1-005 preserves both modes but cannot infer a factor search-size effect from their equality.

QM2-R1-005 classifies Candidate B factor and strategy optimization as likely overfit and both Candidates' combined optimization as likely overfit. QM2-R1-006 applies default-first separate policies, diagnostic-only full search and suspended combined optimization to new research without changing historical objects.

The immutable QM2-R1-005 Manifest froze hashes before one trailing-whitespace cleanup. The original Run remains Git-inconsistent and non-indexable; QM2-R1-005F records exact commit-derived ChangedFile and source-bundle evidence plus a corrects relationship without changing research results.

QM2-R1-007 found zero eligible default-first momentum structures: all defaults exceeded turnover 45 and lacked positive excess/group evidence, and none of thirteen one-hop Trials rescued them. Gates and search scope remained frozen and no Candidate or Promotion state was created.

QM2-R1-008 reduced median annual turnover 34.54% and cost 33.21% with fixed ten-session rebalancing, but none of four pre-registered signals passed every frozen RankIC/stability gate; classification is stock_selection_signal_only with zero Candidate Locks.

The isolated Redis-disabled formal Qlib result persists daily positions but an empty trade list; R1-008 derives holding transitions from positions and uses the CnExchange collector for turnover/cost, so per-trade execution audit is unavailable.

Formal local Qlib completes through the real chain but existing wrappers emit unavailable optional PostgreSQL model-registry and COS /data resolution warnings before using the supplied signal and local Qlib view.

QM2-R2-004 admitted two research Terminal Features and locked nine Archetype-aware Validation objects, but none passed its unchanged Archetype gate and global 10% BH FDR together; no Survivor, Registry, Fresh Lock or Promotion exists.
All project-visible market evidence through 2026-07-23 is retrospective-only; no project-level mature Fresh Cohort, Fresh support or Promotion evidence exists.

The first Supervisor Cycle reused the exhausted Catalog/Program revision and produced zero Retrospective Candidates; QM2-R2-006 supplied and evaluated a genuinely new authorized technical space without relaxing gates.

QM2-R2-006 admitted 20 new unlabeled technical features, but 18 Alpha rounds and 68 formal Qlib calls produced zero Retrospective Candidates under unchanged archetype and FDR gates; no Fresh Lock, Cohort or Promotion exists.

Three preregistered fixed-configuration LightGBM Bundles completed four purged walk-forward Folds, but all failed the unchanged RankIC gate and global BH FDR; no Retrospective Model Candidate or Fresh Lock exists.

The formal Qlib service returns NAV and aggregate execution metrics but does not expose durable holdings/trade tables through the model-program consumer boundary; empty schema-bearing files explicitly mark the missing evidence.
QM2-R2-008 finds that expanded and de-correlated technical Bundles survive only under L1; L5/L10 pooled RankIC is negative and apparent 2024 improvement is not cross-year consistent.

Two L1 retrospective Model Candidates have no-backfill Fresh Locks, but no official observation exists strictly after project exposure through 2026-07-23; no Fresh result, Registry state, Promotion or production evidence exists.
